svg.title: leereilly/star-chart
svg.desc: Star history for leereilly/star-chart over all time. 1 current stars. 1 recorded additions in range. 2026-09-08 to 2026-09-14. Scale: absolute. Display intervals subdivide nominal API weeks; the final week may still be partial. Column height approximates cumulative recorded stars in whole tiles; shading marks distance below each column tip, not value ranges.
